scope: Noether Paper 39 ICM 1932 600ppi source repair for Hyperkomplexe Systeme in ihren Beziehungen zur kommutativen Algebra und Zahlentheorie, rebased after the P38 repair line.

files.scope: P39 source-repair package with cumulative German candidate, official ICM 1932 printed pp.189-194 cutout, six native 600ppi page witnesses, targeted crops, confirmed-fix ledger, no-fix traps, diff, and compile logs.

observed_contents: Corrects Paper 39 title punctuation and author line to source-visible Von Emmy Noether, Gottingen.
Corrects p189 Princip to source Prinzip and restores source italics for the principle sentence.
Restores source wording/style in the crossed-product principle sentence, including die, restricted emphasis, and quotation marks around verschrankten Produkts.
Restores source italics on Definition des verschrankten Produkts at the section 3 opening.
Records no-patch traps for source-visible endlichvielen, formulas (1)-(5 prime), barred a notation, and Hauptgeschlecht symbols that already survived from earlier repair.
Includes two successful XeLaTeX pass logs and refreshed pdftotext output; reported PDF length 458 pages.
caveats: Best-available source repair only; ICM 1932 witness is 600ppi, below the local 650ppi strict certification floor.
Targeted repair and no-patch trap package only; not full Paper 39 line-by-line certification.
Not a critical edition, not whole-Noether closure, and not non-German/multilingual propagation.
This supersedes/extends older P39 local webfix/source-fidelity fragments only as a rebased P39 source-repair package; branch reconciliation remains required before reader promotion.
next_action: Retain for Noether source-audit/provenance staging; upload only with below-650ppi and targeted-repair caveats and do not present as Paper 39 closure.
